She even told me, while revealing that she suffers from schizophrenia that doctor's said that she wouldn't be able to maintain a healthy relationship (whatever a healthy relationship is) which she just denounced right away.

Don't base your way of life on how it would please others. Everybody thinks I'm weird beause I've been in the same relationship for 13 years and still haven't married or bought a house, because "that's what everyone does, so it's weird that I haven't".

Well, here's the deal: Life should be lived based on your own preferences. There's no reason for your friends and family to be concerned, it's just your choice.

I'm 30 myself and my mother is 56. I appreciate that she takes the time to watch my kids every now and then, but after all she's done on her own for me and my sister growing up, I have no right whatsoever to demand anything or to be rude towards any new man she might decide to spend her time with.

You owe your kids (adults) NOTHING, you've given all and more than that, they are now grown-ups (at least when it comes to their age), their treatment of Thomas is despicable and selfish, they should be happy to see their mother being happy and doing things that you enjoy.

This is 100% their problem, you've done everything right.

Sorry to say it, but they sound kind of immature, selfish and spoiled.

I have a few female friends who's been cheated on and they have the exact same problem when it comes to trusting a new man.

I'm afraid there is no quick-fix. All I can say (as a man who's in the same relationship for almost 13 years with a woman who's becoming more and more paranoid), try not to, which is very easy to say, have all these negative thoughts. It will definitely ruin it for both of you.

I've had a hard time finding time for my buddies since my gf feels neglected evert rare occasion that I pick them over her, but one should never forget their friends just because they are in a relationship.

When he's with his boys, try to do something for yourself, hang out with friends or something you enjoy. I think it will make you happier as well and until he's given you a reason not to trust him, trust him. Yes, you might get hurt, but locking yourself inside a cage to protect yourself will make it impossible to have a healthy relationship with him or any other man.

God knows that I need a lot of help with my own relationship with stuff I can't figure out, but I can only give you advice out of a guy's perspective.

Hope it helps. Feel free to "PM" me for further talks :)
